designDecisionsAndRationale: Effective parent mirrors core bpmn/model.ts parentOf: a boundary event whose attachedTo names a non-boundary-event record uses the host's parent; otherwise its own parent. The fallback keeps stored placement for invalid hosts instead of moving them to the orphan process (design 5.3.1).
The ancestor walk keeps a visited set so a parent cycle cannot hang the export (design 5.3.1).
Each sequence flow is placed once in its source's container, which for a legal flow is the container owning both endpoints; this removes the N2 duplicate by construction (design 5.3.1).

Unowned artifacts and associations go into bpmn:collaboration, matching the tCollaboration sequence (participant, messageFlow, artifact); the importer reads them back so the round trip is lossless (design 5.2, 5.3 Order item 1).
The duplicate-id scan covers the id space the importer enforces plus model/DI XML ID uniqueness; extension vocabularies have their own id scopes (design 5.3.1, review DR-1).
intentionalTradeoffs: An illegal cross-container sequence flow is emitted once in its source's container rather than in every container holding an endpoint (design 5.3.1).

A source XML boundary event outside its host's lane gets its lane rewritten to the host's lane on the second import; bpmnSemanticProjection parent may differ; equivalence.ts and import lane mapping are not changed (design 14). The implementer stops if reference.test.ts fails on it.
The safeguard warns rather than repairs, so strict export exits 3 instead of writing a file the importer rejects (design 5.3.1, section 8).

Boundary event with no parent attached to a task inside an expanded sub-process (plan 03 test 2).
Pool-less task plus parentless text annotation: orphan process keeps the task, annotation goes to the collaboration (plan 03 test 3).
Associations to a pooled task vs. to a participant (plan 03 test 4).
Lane parent cycle on a pool-less page terminates (plan 03 test 5).
Model id colliding with a derived DI id (A and A_di) is reported; repeated ids inside extensionElements are not (plans 02 and 04).
Boundary event whose host is missing, is a boundary event, or is pool-less keeps its own parent or goes with its host to the orphan process.
Collapsed participant content stays unexported with its existing warning; flows from it are not emitted.
